additional_controlled_restart.reason: Apply tested batch menu prefetch with identical logical record order within each invocation; no target-dependent selection.
additional_controlled_restart.limitation: The inherited resume traversal starts again at the first pair; it does not guarantee the same sampled prefix as an uninterrupted live run. Published raw bytes, IDs and split are the reproducibility artifacts. Interrupted invocation metadata remains unfinished rather than being assigned an invented completion time.

resumption_reason: The initial uncommitted concurrent scheduler was replaced by its tested final implementation, which lets Retry-After install a cooldown while another worker awaits admission. The exact verified collector PID was stopped; existing raw bytes and request evidence were preserved and verified on resume.

initial_invocation.source_revision: initial uncommitted batch scheduler; exact commit unavailable
initial_invocation.completion_status: forced process stop; original unfinished invocation retained

sampling.manufacturers: all names supplied by each model-year make menu

cache_performance_controlled_restart.reason: Apply tested compact atomic cache-index write once per successful batch-wave; per-response raw/journal/manifest evidence retained.
cache_performance_controlled_restart.recorded_attempts_note: Snapshot attempts count durable recorded attempts; interrupted in-flight HTTP requests may not have produced retained responses.
